event.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Causes Major Fire at Saint Petersburg Warehouse
event.canonical_title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Causes Major Fire at Saint Petersburg Warehouse
event.summary: A Ukrainian drone strike ignited a significant fire at a Wildberries warehouse near Saint Petersburg on July 24. The blaze produced thick smoke that spread across the city and led to temporary disruptions at Pulkovo Airport, as reported by Russian authorities.

timeline.title: Polish PM Reports Possible Russian Missile Downed in Eastern Poland
timeline.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that a missile that fell in eastern Poland overnight appears to be Russian. Authorities discovered a crater and debris in a field following reports of an explosion.
key_facts: A missile fell in eastern Poland.
Polish authorities found a crater and debris.
Prime Minister Donald Tusk indicated the missile is likely Russian.

timeline.title: Russian Strikes Near Kyiv Result in Four Fatalities During Zelensky's Visit to Serbia
timeline.summary: Russian missile strikes in the Kyiv region have killed four people, including a child, as local authorities reported multiple casualties. The attacks occurred shortly after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's arrival in Serbia for a significant visit. The strikes have raised concerns about Ukraine's air defense capabilities amidst ongoing military tensions.
key_facts: Four people killed, including a child, in Russian missile strikes near Kyiv.
The attacks coincided with President Zelensky's visit to Serbia.
Local authorities reported multiple casualties and damage from falling debris.
